facts.business: Galada Power and Telecommunication Limited is a company with no operations, negative net worth, and ongoing losses, currently in the process of revival and revamping its manufacturing facilities under an NCLT-approved Resolution Plan.

auditor.name: Brahmayya & Co.
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Material Uncertainty Related to Going Concern: The Resolution Plan approved by NCLT Hyderabad Bench is fully implemented. Though there were no operations, net worth is negative, and the company continues to incur losses, financial statements are prepared on a going concern basis as the company is in process of revival and revamping its manufacturing facilities.

key_risks: Material uncertainty related to going concern due to no operations, negative net worth, and continuing losses
Non-recognition of deferred tax assets due to uncertainty of future taxable profits
Dependence on successful revival and revamping of manufacturing facilities
